name: Release {OS}
tagline: Ship it: release boundaries, rollout, rollback and the incident path.

commands.name: /release
commands.does: Open the release authority and report the candidate inputs

commands.name: /boundary
commands.does: Fix what is in, what is out, and the version

commands.name: /release-candidate
commands.does: Assemble the candidate and its evidence pack

commands.name: /release-gate
commands.does: Record the go or no-go decision with its owner and abort criteria

commands.name: /rollout
commands.does: Plan and run a canary, progressive, staged or full rollout

commands.name: /deploy
commands.does: Execute one rollout stage, an approval boundary every time

commands.name: /verify-production
commands.does: Exercise the real golden path and read the real signals

commands.name: /observability
commands.does: Define or check what is measured, alerted and paged

commands.name: /rollback-plan
commands.does: Write the way back before deploying, with its limits

commands.name: /rollback
commands.does: Execute the rollback and state the data implications

commands.name: /incident
commands.does: Contain, record the timeline, decide, communicate

commands.name: /handoff
commands.does: Hand runbooks, observability and the customer change onward

requires_human_approval_for: proceeding on a bypassed or risk-accepted gate, which also needs a Review & Governance {OS} exception
executing a rollback that involves a data migration
any release whose rollback path is untested or unavailable
using or touching production customer data during verification
